file_note: The three false negatives from one session (3.4) plus the detector that was pointed at the wrong artifact (3.6d). One rule governs all four: a negative is only as strong as the oracle's ability to express the positive, so the oracle must be shown to see a planted positive before its silence counts. Every false member here is a false NEGATIVE, which is the half of the discipline the private corpus never measured. RE-EXPRESSED after an external critique: ext17 previously compared two declared labels, artifact_scanned against artifact_claimed, both written by the same author. The scanned path is now derived from the detector's own recorded invocation -- its argv and the files it opened -- so only the claim side is a declaration and the two halves of the comparison have different provenance.

cases.note: The pattern carries a real carriage return where an escape was intended, and the sink normalises line endings, so the oracle cannot match anything the sink can emit.
